messages:
maya-csm: FYI Nimbus QBR on Tue 4/1. During onboarding we noticed a big embedding ramp from their new cohort. Can we do a 15m triage to lock a short-term budget gate and a QBR slide? :wave:
owen-finops: Saw it in the nightly job too. Their avg tokens/day jumped ~1.8k -> ~48k. If that keeps up, rough add’l monthly $ ~5.8k. Recommend provisional daily cap + staged alerts. :money_with_wings:
liam-embed-ops: We have two levers: enable adaptive batching + prefix KV caching (best long term), and a provisional per-account soft-cap for immediate protection. Adaptive batching could lower unit cost ~20-30% depending on prompt similarity.
sarah-qa: If we ship a soft-cap, I'll run a quick regression across the embed ingestion and the realtime path. Need the exact behavior (429, header, response body) to assert for consumers.
maya-csm: Proposed immediate plan: provisional daily cap 60k, alerts at 60/85/95% that notify CSM+FinOps, soft-throttle at 90% with override. Liam, can you scope a quick feature-flag rollout to Nimbus? I'll notify the customer.
owen-finops: Draft alert rules below 12 engineerable?
```\nalerts:\n  daily_cap: 60000\n  thresholds_pct: [60,85,95]\n  notify: [\"maya-csm\",\"owen-finops\"]\n  soft_throttle_at_pct: 90\n  escalation_window: \"2h > 120% -> pager to eng-oncall\"\n```\nliam-embed-ops: Yep we can implement that. Soft-throttle will return 429 + json body {"code":"soft_throttle","estimate":...}. We'll gate it behind a feature flag and flip on for Nimbus first. Also will prototype adaptive batching on the batch endpoint; should be non-breaking.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-embed-spike-3111112222. Notifications sent to #customer-success and owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Thanks for the rapid response 12 can you also enable batching on the batch-embedding endpoint? That would smooth peaks. We'll compile top 10 prompts and expected concurrency.
maya-csm: Great. Liam + Sarah, please add a short test checklist and error contract to the shared QBR doc: https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus-qbr. Owen, can you drop a conservative spend table and renewal-risk blurb?
owen-finops: On it. I'll add a conservative projection and mark renewal risk as "monitoring - medium" because usage spike is large but ARR is solid. Will update after triage.
maya-csm: Plan to close before EOW so the QBR slide shows mitigation + costs. Thanks team :thumbsup:
